newsitem.title: KENYA: Zaire rebel leader meets U.N. envoy, again rejects ceasefire.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebel leader meets U.N. envoy, again rejects ceasefire.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila met U.N. special envoy Mohamed Sahnoun on Thursday in the northern Ugandan town of Gulu but again rejected U.N. pleas for a ceasefire, diplomats said on Friday.

The diplomats, told Reuters by telephone from the Ugandan capital Kampala, that the meeting in the war-torn outpost was hosted by Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni, who is in Gulu supervising a government offensive against Sudan-backed Ugandan rebels.
